finding: A daily Buffer metrics read can contain older per-post update times. Preserve metricsUpdatedAt alongside captured_at and actual post age; never label the retrieval as an exact 24h or 72h sample. Keep platform and metric definitions separate when Buffer reach differs from native viewers.

evidence.result: 29 October retrieval carried 27-28 October updates. Instagram native viewers was 6 and Buffer reach 7; both readings retained without forcing agreement. On 30 October, TikTok reach changed from 0 to 68 while views stayed 77, with an older provider timestamp. A refreshed count is not necessarily new audience since the previous retrieval.

revisit_when: Metric definitions or refresh behavior change; compare like-for-like windows before a verdict.
